correctness.rationale: Private-neighbor equivalence is proved directly, and two independent standalone programs enumerate all vertex masks for cycles n=3,...,11 by different minimality tests. All 462 five-coordinate supports of C11 have at most 29 of the 32 traces; a four-query witness proves VC=4. A complete depth-five 31-query tree supplies 32 distinct consistent terminal witnesses; 44 hypotheses exclude depth six. For n<11, exact VC enumeration meets the floor-log2 concept-count upper bound, forcing equality with Littlestone. Cartesian-product and online-mistake arguments prove exact dimensions 4m,5m for arbitrary disjoint unions. A separate 22-concept maximal independent subset comparison is verified. The self-contained paths and computation results were replayed.

value.rationale: A first exact cutoff in the natural inclusion-minimal domination hypergraphs of connected cycles, complete 462-support five-query trace distribution, and a strict same-graph contrast against maximal-independent-set membership provide structural information beyond recomputing hypothesis counts. The 11-cycle gives a vertex-transitive two-regular base for an unbounded adaptive/static separation; its base case is not implied by the previously studied path or maximal-independent-set objects. The precise support spectrum and first-gap boundary are natural exact learning invariants, useful for extremal online-vs-static comparisons, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The result does not purport to classify larger connected cycles.
